notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where user wouldn't get achievement "Dun n Dun" even when all DVDs (excluding the gauntlet rush) were completed
- Fixed a bug where Modern Defense Bot would display incorrect sprite when defeated from Spawn Command Power
- Fixed a bug where Transition screen would stay on screen, potentially blocking buttons, if you made a move right when it was transitioning on screen to signify your death. Now it will move off screen when textbox is out and HP is at or below 0.
- Fixed a bug on the Crazed Commander Hard mode boss fight where using Spark X would crash the game.

notes.title: V. 1.01
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where using drugs on the Speaker HR rep fight would kill the music.
- Fixed a bug where if you took your turn as the Game Over Card was scrolling on screen on the Speaker HR rep fight, the ui would get stuck and you'd need to click the "OK" button underneath it. Now, your turn will be forfeit if you died period.
- Fixed a bug where Mini Skill UI wouldn't display "Mini Skill Equipped" when Mini Skill is clicked on
- Fixed a bug where Mini Skill UI wouldn't Display tutorial for how to get Mini Skills unless player had at least one mini skill. Now Tutorial will display even with no Mini Skills unlocked.
- Tedious Tutor Custom Fight Reworks
- Fixed a bug where the Psychotic Salesman swinging would display incorrect damage given to player.
- Added a ui element in Mini Skill that tells the player what skill they currently have equipped
- Improved the Hint given by the Mini Skill "Sixth Sense" to make the hint appear bigger so you don't have to squint your eyes to see what the hint was.
- Some hints given by the Mini Skill "Sixth Sense" didn't make sense in the Psychotic Salesman Hard and Base Fight. They have been tweaked to be more accurate.
- Fixed a bug where player was not able to get the Achievement "I have a particular set of skills" even if they did equip every Mini Skill. Now all you have to do is go to the Mini Skill select with all Mini Skills unlocked to get the achievement
- Minor Spelling/grammatical fixes
- Tweaked one of the endings slightly. (Not the "Good Ending")

notes.title: Self Defense Kinda... Demo New Updates
notes.notes:
Self Defense Kinda... Demo V. 2.1 Patch Notes
- Added Animations for bosses and player hud
- Added new Font/Text typing out system
- Added moving wavy font (able to be disabled in settings)
- Changed UI
- Added dynamic numbers (ex: Command Power number bounces up and down when hovering over a command power)
- UI will now not be brought out if not able to be used (ex: Hit me with no coins)
- Command Power UI now goes 50% transparent if you can't afford it
- Hard Mode remembers if it was on
- Restart R key now takes you back to main menu not to boot screen
- Added player damage sound effect

notes.title: Major update now released for Self Defense Kinda... Demo
notes.notes:
Lots of feedback has been submitted for Self Defense Kinda... demo so a pretty major update is in order.

What was added?
- New (optional) Tutorial cutscene to explain mechanics and how game flow will go
- Minor Rework to Arising Actress, Bartender, and Psychotic Salesman Fights
- Auto Stat adjuster option. On by default it will automatically adjust stats to a recommended level so you don't have to guess what stats will make the fight fair (toggle able in settings)
- New Camera Shake effect when taking damage (toggle able in settings)

Additionally, the demo has gotten so many downloads and so much support!
Thanks is also in order so, for that reason, the Tyrannical TV and Monetized Menace were added in as a part of this update.

Thank you for your support and please continue enjoying the game!

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.notes:
Get the chance to try three fights from across various parts of the game and their hard modes FOR FREE! You'll be able to see what the whole gist with the game is. Note it is only a demo and things are subject to change and that hard modes are completely optional. It's also a sandbox type demo. Every fight, hard mode fight, ability, and upgrade is available upon boot. I'll also try to get a sneak peek at documentation for Custom Fight system to showcase what I plan to have available for people to be able to make. This will also allow everyone to input suggestions for tools to have or anything to tweak.

If you'd like to submit any feedback, you can do so via email (teamfuryhelp@gmail.com) or by the pinned community discussion labeled "Demo Feedback". Enjoy the demo!
